title: Build Settings and unified Appearance
head: The final evidence commit is the PR head; implementation_head identifies tested code.

github_recheck.parent_ci: All active current-head checks successful; conditional jobs skipped.
github_recheck.base_decision: Continue corrected unmerged D29; dedicated worktree and owner main preserved. Not a standalone-main compatibility claim.

source_pins.A02: Existing tokens.css and root data-theme; no token edits
source_pins.A20: Existing settings and tutorial reset owners; no second settings store

design_reference.inspection: Native Settings inspected in Chrome; screenshot retained privately.
design_reference.limits: Visual comparison, not a pixel diff or complete UI35 export. Unsupported sample preferences are not copied.

host_requirements: Authenticated scope-bound request and write permission; retire controller on logout, transport, account or permission replacement.
All four explicit F25 destination callbacks: authority, connections, voice-settings, advanced-settings.
Optional replay callback delegates to replayExistingTutorial; never setup/profile/all reset.
Verify combined authenticated host, legacy destinations and hosted tutorial continuation before enabling.

mapping.appearance: Existing jarvis-theme storage and data-theme root; subscribed by every mounted selector.
mapping.voice: F23 standard_tts listed choice; PATCH revision + voice only.
mapping.natural_realtime_voice: Existing voice settings destination; no inferred toggle or entitlement.
mapping.check_in_frequency: Unavailable; disabled choices with no selected value.

implementation: Strict canonical read/save validation, scope cancellation, fresh readback and no automatic mutation retries.
Revision conflicts preserve selection for explicit discard/reload. Lost acknowledgments reconcile before retry and avoid a second write when already saved.
Persisted preference and live application are separate outcomes. Restart/apply-failed warnings survive polling.
Shared external theme subscriber synchronizes same-page hooks, root, menus and other tabs without replacing focused content.
Hosted provider setup remains managed; links remain with F25. Shared accessible controls and centered native tutorial confirmation.

verification.command: D27_F22_SETUP_MODULE=/tmp/d27-f22-pin/ui/src/brief/connections/setup.ts D29_F23_ROOT=/path/to/pinned/f23 D30_F23_ROOT=/path/to/pinned/f23 bun test ui/src/brief ui/src/v2/shell/useTheme.test.tsx
verification.note: Existing optional F07/F08 skips. Before only the final dialog-centering CSS edit; final focused tests and normal hooks pass.

verification.proof: Actual F23 routes and temporary SQLite/secrets; voice-only persistence, restart, conflict, lost reply, application statuses, hosted silent defaults and disabled provider.

commit_hooks.note: Normal license, migrations, templates, package, related tests and TypeScript; no bypass or co-author trailers.

browser.console: No warning/error entries observed in final preview.

not_run: Combined production authenticated host and F25 navigation destinations
Production activation, real settings/account mutation or audio provider call
Physical touch, screen reader or other browser
Pixel diff or complete UI35 export
Whole repository test suite locally; PR CI tracked separately

preview.isolation: Loopback static server rejects APIs; in-memory synthetic settings reset on reload.

rollback: Remove optional registration or restore existing Settings. Revert card commits including shared theme subscriber if needed; no migration/data rollback.
private_progress: Outside product repository; shared Drive roadmap unchanged.
